about: Planned session dates that have no topic yet. The signed-out start page lists them under «Coming up» and offers the next one as «Save the date». A date drops out by itself once it has passed or once a session in sessions.json has the same date. time (HH:MM, Zurich) and room are optional, as in sessions.json.

note.en: One week later for the New Year
note.fr: Une semaine plus tard à cause du Nouvel An
